title: Heavy periods
claims: Signs of heavy periods include needing to change a pad or tampon every 1 to 2 hours, or emptying a menstrual cup more often than recommended.
Other signs include needing to use two types of period product together, periods lasting more than 7 days, and passing blood clots larger than about 2.5 cm.
Bleeding through clothes or bedding is also listed as a sign of heavy periods.
The page advises seeing a GP if heavy periods are affecting your life, have lasted some time, cause severe pain, or you bleed between periods or after sex.
Bleeding between periods or after sex should be checked by a GP.
